description: This file defines a class 'NumberValue' used to represent DynamoDB Number (N) values within the AWS SDK for PHP, providing mechanisms for serialization and string conversion.

classes.name: NumberValue
classes.description: A class representing a DynamoDB Number (N) value, encapsulating the number as a string and providing serialization and string conversion methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the number value, accepting string, integer, or float, and stores it as a string.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Implements the JsonSerializable interface to allow the object to be serialized into its string value for JSON encoding.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number value.
